personal.name: Abdelrahman Essam
personal.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
personal.summary: Senior Software Engineer with experience in Functional Safety Embedded Software Engineering, hardware design, and embedded systems development. Proficient in Embedded C, C++, Python, and TCL, with expertise in microcontroller architectures, IoT platforms, hardware design, and software development for automotive, robotics, aerospace, railway, and agriculture applications.

professional.experienceSummary: Experienced in embedded software and hardware development, Functional Safety Engineering, tool engineering, customer technical interface, and research and development. Professional experience includes automotive, robotics, railway, aerospace, and agriculture applications. Responsibilities have included embedded software development, HAL development, hardware design, software performance analysis, automated tooling, testing, and CI/CD implementation.

workExperience.description: Embedded software development and Functional Safety Engineering for automotive and robotics applications. Responsibilities include developing C code following MISRA guidelines, software performance analysis, HAL development for multiple microcontrollers and SoCs, embedded software R&D, hardware design, customer interface, and tool engineering.

workExperience.position: Instructor & Technical Support — IoT, Robotics and Embedded Systems
workExperience.description: Delivered comprehensive training sessions on IoT, robotics, and embedded systems through hands-on workshops and interactive technical support.
Designed and developed embedded devices including both software and hardware as complete products.

projects.description: Implemented Functional Safety software for an Autonomous Warehouse Robot Wrapper system.

projects.name: ESP32 Walkie-Talkie

projects.name: Smart Chicken Farm Monitoring & Control System

projects.name: IoT Products
